name: MATLAS-1332 (Hubble)
blurb: MATLAS-1332, an ultra-diffuse dwarf galaxy with a bright nucleus, seen by Hubble.
label: matlas1332-hubble
story: A faint, spread-out dwarf galaxy with a bright nucleus at its heart, living in a quieter, less crowded neighborhood of the cosmos. Hubble looked here for the globular clusters that gather around such ghostly galaxies.

claims.text: MATLAS-1332 is one of the ultra-diffuse galaxies in the MATLAS Hubble study
MATLAS-1332 is a nucleated dwarf (elliptical) galaxy
The MATLAS UDGs are found in lower density environments
Hubble imaging was used to find the globular clusters of these galaxies
MATLAS-1332 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy target of the Hubble program
